prompt:

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a Roman marble bath hall — columns, mosaic floors and a wide steaming pool lit from high windows
Outfit: a vintage aviatrix look — a cropped leather flight jacket over a fitted top, high-waisted jodhpurs, goggles pushed up on her head and tall boots — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, rust, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; right now — one strap — or one side of the neckline — has slipped down off her shoulder, baring that whole shoulder and the top of her arm; she leaves it as it is, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: lying on her front.
SUPPORT: she lies on her front, propped on her forearms.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body facing the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands cup her chin, her forearms propped beneath her.
LEGS: lower legs raised behind her, ankles loosely crossed.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — lithium: the lightest metal of all, so soft it cuts with a knife and so light it floats on oil; a fresh cut shines silver-white, then dulls to dark grey in open air; it burns with a vivid crimson flame; it stores and releases power inside every rechargeable battery; found in 1817 in a pale stone called petalite and named for stone; drawn from turquoise brine ponds on high salt flats; a medicine that calms a restless mind — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.
